spec.rawSql: SELECT mydate AS time, COALESCE(NULLIF(title,''), mynote) AS text FROM workout.notes WHERE mydate IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(mydate)
SELECT total_workouts AS "Total Workouts" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT lifetime_volume AS "Lifetime Volume (lb)" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT total_hours AS "Training Hours" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT current_bodyweight AS "Current Bodyweight (lb)" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT streak_weeks AS "Streak (weeks)" FROM workout.v_current_streak

SELECT CASE canonical_name WHEN 'Barbell Bench Press' THEN 'Bench' WHEN 'Barbell Squat' THEN 'Squat' WHEN 'Barbell Deadlift' THEN 'Deadlift' WHEN 'Barbell Shoulder Press' THEN 'Shoulder Press' END AS "Lift", actual_1rm AS "Actual", CASE WHEN has_true_single THEN 'single' ELSE 'set' END AS "Basis", round(est_1rm)::int AS "Est." FROM workout.v_one_rep_max WHERE canonical_name IN ('Barbell Bench Press','Barbell Squat','Barbell Deadlift','Barbell Shoulder Press') ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['Barbell Bench Press','Barbell Squat','Barbell Deadlift','Barbell Shoulder Press']::text[], canonical_name)

spec.description: Actual 1RM = heaviest true single (reps=1) if logged, else heaviest weight lifted at any rep (Basis: single vs set). Estimated 1RM = best Epley estimate. As you log quarterly 1RM days, the Basis flips from 'set' to 'single'.
spec.title: 1RM — actual vs estimated

spec.rawSql:
SELECT week AS time, canonical_name AS metric, CASE WHEN '${score_basis}' = 'heaviest' THEN heaviest_score ELSE avg_score END AS score FROM workout.v_rel_strength_week WHERE $__timeFilter(week) AND (
  ('${exercise}' <> 'None' AND canonical_name = '${exercise}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' <> 'None' AND muscle_group = '${muscle}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' = 'None' AND '${area}' <> 'None' AND muscle_area = '${area}')
) ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Pounds lifted per pound of bodyweight, over time. Toggle heaviest-set vs average-set with Score basis. Pick a muscle group / muscle / exercise above to populate.
spec.title: Strength Score over time  —  ${score_basis} lifted ÷ bodyweight

spec.rawSql:
SELECT workout_date AS time, canonical_name AS metric, max(est_1rm)::numeric(10,1) AS est_1rm FROM workout.v_sets WHERE is_working AND $__timeFilter(workout_date) AND (
  ('${exercise}' <> 'None' AND canonical_name = '${exercise}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' <> 'None' AND muscle_group = '${muscle}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' = 'None' AND '${area}' <> 'None' AND muscle_area = '${area}')
) GROUP BY workout_date, canonical_name ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Best working-set Epley 1RM per day (weight x (1 + reps/30)), computed from your sets.
spec.title: Estimated 1RM over time

spec.rawSql:
SELECT workout_date AS time, canonical_name AS metric, max(weight_lbs) AS "heaviest (lb)" FROM workout.v_sets WHERE $__timeFilter(workout_date) AND (
  '${set_type}' = 'all'
  OR ('${set_type}' = 'working' AND set_type <> 'warm-up')
  OR ('${set_type}' = 'warm-up' AND set_type = 'warm-up')
) AND (
  ('${exercise}' <> 'None' AND canonical_name = '${exercise}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' <> 'None' AND muscle_group = '${muscle}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' = 'None' AND '${area}' <> 'None' AND muscle_area = '${area}')
) GROUP BY workout_date, canonical_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT lpad(reps::text, 2, '0') AS "reps", canonical_name AS metric, max_weight AS "max weight (lb)" FROM workout.v_strength_curve WHERE 1=1 AND (
  ('${exercise}' <> 'None' AND canonical_name = '${exercise}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' <> 'None' AND muscle_group = '${muscle}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' = 'None' AND '${area}' <> 'None' AND muscle_area = '${area}')
) ORDER BY reps

spec.description: For each rep count, the heaviest you've lifted. Pick a single exercise for a clean drop-off curve to plan working weights.
spec.title: Strength Curve — heaviest weight at each rep count

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', workout_date)::date AS time, canonical_name AS metric, sum(volume) AS "volume (lb)" FROM workout.v_sets WHERE is_working AND $__timeFilter(workout_date) AND (
  ('${exercise}' <> 'None' AND canonical_name = '${exercise}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' <> 'None' AND muscle_group = '${muscle}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' = 'None' AND '${area}' <> 'None' AND muscle_area = '${area}')
) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT canonical_name AS "Exercise", reps AS "Reps", max_weight AS "Max weight (lb)", times_done AS "# sets" FROM workout.v_strength_curve WHERE 1=1 AND (
  ('${exercise}' <> 'None' AND canonical_name = '${exercise}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' <> 'None' AND muscle_group = '${muscle}')
  OR ('${exercise}' = 'None' AND '${muscle}' = 'None' AND '${area}' <> 'None' AND muscle_area = '${area}')
) ORDER BY canonical_name, reps

spec.title: Rep PRs — max weight at each rep count

spec.rawSql: SELECT muscle_area AS "Muscle group", sum(volume) AS "Volume" FROM workout.v_sets WHERE is_working AND $__timeFilter(workout_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT muscle_area AS "Muscle group", ROUND(max(rel_weight) FILTER (WHERE is_working), 3) AS "Best score" FROM workout.v_sets_rel WHERE $__timeFilter(workout_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.title: Best Strength Score by Muscle Group (heaviest ÷ bodyweight)

spec.rawSql: SELECT muscle_area AS metric, sum(volume) AS volume FROM workout.v_sets WHERE is_working AND $__timeFilter(workout_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT date_trunc('week', workout_date)::date AS time, muscle_area AS metric, sum(volume) AS volume FROM workout.v_sets WHERE is_working AND $__timeFilter(workout_date) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT canonical_name AS "Exercise", lifetime_volume AS "Volume" FROM workout.v_exercise_totals ORDER BY lifetime_volume DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15
SELECT period AS time, workouts AS "workouts/wk" FROM workout.v_consistency_week WHERE $__timeFilter(period) ORDER BY 1
SELECT period AS time, workouts AS "workouts/mo" FROM workout.v_consistency_month WHERE $__timeFilter(period) ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('week', starttime)::date AS time, avg(workout_minutes) AS "avg min" FROM workout.sessions WHERE starttime IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(starttime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', s.starttime)::date AS time, avg(ss.total_sets) AS "sets/workout" FROM workout.v_session_stats ss JOIN workout.sessions s ON s.id = ss.session_id WHERE s.starttime IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(s.starttime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT mydate AS time, weight_lbs AS "bodyweight (lb)", fat_pct AS "fat %" FROM workout.v_bodyweight WHERE $__timeFilter(mydate) ORDER BY 1
SELECT mydate AS time, chest, arms, waist, shoulders, thighs, calves, neck, forearms, hips FROM workout.v_bodyweight WHERE $__timeFilter(mydate) ORDER BY 1
